<div class="card-body">
'''Pops''' is the Japanese-language [[Premiere (Japanese)]] printing of [[Pops]].<ref name="encyclopedia">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41 and 99 (index 4081). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="photograph">[https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/star-wars-ccg-japanese-premiere/imagegallery/29544 PSA collector gallery]; [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/141635843/aNtHyYX_fEiVYJmscFt6cA.jpg original Japanese card photograph].</ref>

'''Incomplete documentation:''' Rule-derived attributes and card relationships have not yet been verified. Comparison with the English printing has not yet been reviewed.

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ポップス</span><ref name="photograph" />
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">彼が操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に＋２。ゴールド５を操縦している場合、さらに回避値に＋１し、戦闘運命数を引けない場合も、１回だけ引くことができる。</span><ref name="photograph" />
<h2>Lore</h2>
<span lang="ja">ヤヴィンの戦いにおけるゴールド５のパイロット。本名はデイヴィッシュ・クレイル。飛行歴20年のベテランで、ゴールドリーダーの編隊で片翼を担う。</span><ref name="photograph" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''English reading aid (AI translation)'''

'''Lore:''' Pilot of [[Gold 5]] at the Battle of Yavin. His real name is Davish Krail. A veteran with 20 years of flying experience, he flies on one wing of [[Dutch|Gold Leader]]’s formation.<ref name="photograph" />

'''Game text:''' Adds 2 to the power of a starship he pilots. If piloting [[Gold 5]], also adds 1 to maneuver and may draw one battle destiny even when otherwise unable to draw battle destiny.<ref name="photograph" />
